summary: Tested Mobile Money (Orange/MTN) without OTP, in the UI and with a quick backend check. Everything requested works. 1) /sales Orange Money: no OTP section, button or 'En cours de développement' badge. 'N° Destinataire *' and 'Réf. Paiement Marchand *' fields are shown. 2) The sender number fills itself when a customer is selected (Centre de Santé Matam -> +224 624 44 44 44, Christmass Antonia -> +224 627 01 01 01). It clears when the customer is removed, and manual entry works. 3) Submitting without a reference shows an error toast and creates no sale. With a reference, sale VNT-3EE5DA53 was created and the receipt popup appeared. The sale detail shows 'Orange Money' and sale-detail-payment-ref shows '+224 624 44 44 44 · Réf. MP260120.2211.TEST01'. 4) Mixed payment (cash + MTN): second-mode fields marked '*', no OTP. Error toasts 'MTN Money : veuillez saisir N° Destinataire' then '... Réf. Paiement Marchand'. Sale VNT-EEAB67D7 was created and split_payments[1].details was saved. 5) Debts: I created a debt (Christmass Antonia limit set to 5000, credit sale VNT-544C3C5C of 1600). In the repayment dialog with Orange Money: no OTP, Encaisser button enabled, number pre-filled. Error toast 'Veuillez saisir : Réf. Paiement Marchand' when the reference is missing. Repayment of 1600 GNF recorded, receipt popup shown, payment_details saved. 6) /settings: no 'Paiements Mobile Money (OTP)' section and no 'OTP' text. 7) Reports consistent: by_payment_method sums to 7500 = total_revenue (credit 2500, cash 1200, mtn 1300, orange 2500); cash_collected 7500 = 7500 - 2500 + 2500 - 0.

minor.issue: A debt_id that is not a valid UUID (e.g. GET /api/debts/payments) returns 500 Internal Server Error (ValueError 'badly formed hexadecimal UUID string' in routes/debts.py get_debt, line 433). It should return 404 or 422.
The leftover OTP verification route is still in routes/payment_methods.py (around line 258). The UI no longer uses it; consider removing it for consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: For split payments, the detail dialog shows the method and amount but not the Mobile Money number/reference of the split part. sale-detail-payment-ref only renders selectedSale.payment_details, not split_payments[].details. The data is stored and the printed receipt (receipt.js) does show it.

issues: The error toast for a missing reference reads 'Veuillez saisir: Réf. Paiement Marchand' (generic validatePaymentDetails), not the expected 'Veuillez saisir la référence du paiement marchand'. The check in handleSubmit is never reached. Works fine; wording only.
The Code Promo placeholder 'PROMO2026' is dark enough to look like an entered value.
The Réf. Paiement Marchand placeholder is cut off ('Ex: MP260120.2211.A0') in the narrow two-column layout.
The 'Ouverture de Caisse' (open shift) modal opens automatically for the admin even though the admin is exempt from shifts. It can be closed with Escape or X.

action_items: Optional: show split_payments[].details (number + reference) in the sale detail dialog for mixed payments
Optional: validate the UUID in GET /api/debts/{debt_id} and return 404 instead of 500
Optional: widen or stack the debt dialog Mobile Money fields so the placeholder is not cut off
critical_code_review_comments: Sales.js is 3363 lines and Debts.js is 1489 lines. Split them into smaller components (payment fields, mixed payment, sale detail dialog).
Sales.js handleSubmit: the Mobile Money check (around line 883) duplicates validatePaymentDetails, which runs first. Remove one of them.
Prefill effect in Sales.js: changing the customer overwrites a number the user typed by hand. This is acceptable, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created test sales VNT-3EE5DA53 (Orange Money 1600), VNT-EEAB67D7 (mixed cash 800 + MTN 800) and VNT-544C3C5C (credit 1600, Christmass Antonia), plus a 1600 Orange Money debt repayment (ref MP260120.DEBT.TEST03). Each used product '3HP KIT GEL/2 + CP/4 KIT/14', 3 units of stock in total. Christmass Antonia's max_debt_limit was temporarily set to 5000 and then restored to 0 (current_debt 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login opens an 'Ouverture de Caisse' modal on /sales and /debts; press Escape. Product '9 VIT INJ AMP' now has 0 stock; use '3HP KIT' (stock about 87). Mixed payment checkbox: '[data-testid=sale-form] input[type=checkbox]'. Second mode select trigger text: 'Choisir le second mode'. Debt dialog: amount input #amount. Token key in the login response: access_token.
